name: folio-reader
description: A quiet mobile Markdown reader with Mermaid, code, mathematics, and an offline library.

scripts.build:portable: vite build --base / --outDir portable-dist && node scripts/verify-build.mjs portable-dist /
scripts.check: node --check app.js && node --check renderer.js && node --check storage.js && node --check share-target.js && node --check vite.config.js && node --check native.js && node --check listening/index.js && node --check listening/model.js && node --check listening/controller.js && node --check listening/providers.js
scripts.build:android: node scripts/collect-notices.mjs && vite build --base / --outDir native-dist && node scripts/verify-build.mjs native-dist / && cap sync android
